title: Plumb.
officialText: Supported scaffold poles, legs, posts, frames, and uprights shall be plumb and braced to prevent swaying and displacement. The tolerance shall not exceed L/100, where L is the distance measured from the ground or grade elevation to the first X-brace or bottom of the first bearer or frame horizontal member.
